newsitem.title: USA: Temple cites Q3 costs, Q4 may restore prices.
newsitem.headline: Temple cites Q3 costs, Q4 may restore prices.

text.p: Temple-Inland Inc on Monday attributed lower third quarter results to renovation costs of its Alabama particleboard plant and ongoing start-up costs at its particleboard plant in Arkansas.
The company said similar renovations to its Diboll, Texas, particleboard plant are scheduled to begin in January.
Earlier in the day the company reported that third quarter results had fallen to $0.59 per share from $1.51 a year ago.
First Call estimates put the company's earnings at $0.54 per share for the quarter.
The company said prices for corrugated containers and containerboard fell significantly early in the quarter but stabilized by the quarter's end as demand recovered.
If increased demand continues, "some restoration of pricing will be achieved during the fourth quarter," the company said, adding that certain price increases have already been announced.
